ConfigurableProduct:19559.meta_description: This Dog Collar with name & contact number is a must-have for every pet. Order your personalised Dog Collars now & enjoy fast printing & shipping in Australia.
ConfigurableProduct:19559.faq:
How do I wash my personalised Dog Collar?

We recommend popping your dog collar in the washing machine on a cold cycle. Alternatively, you can hand-wash it in the sink with some soap.

Which Size Collar Will Fit My Dog?

We recommend you measure your dog's neck & choose your collar size based on the measurements: Extra Small Collar: 24-35cm long. If your dog's neck measures larger than 35cms around, you will need a small or large collar. Small Collar: 29-44cm long. If your dog's neck measures larger than 44cms around, you will need a large collar. Large Collar: 39-64cm long. If your dog's neck measures less than 39 cms around, you might like to try the small personalised collar. If your dog's neck measures more than 64cms around, you may have mistaken a horse for your dog. Unfortunately, we do not have any collars that measure larger than 64cms in length at this stage.

What are the buckles & clasps made from?

The buckle & adjustment clasp on these custom Dog Collars are made from durable plastic. They're both lightweight & rust-proof.

What does the inside of the Dog Collar look like?

The inside of our Dog Collars are black so it's super easy to keep them looking clean while your dog is wearing it.

What material is this Dog Collar made from?

Our Dog Collars are made from a durable woven polyester webbing. They're super tough, washable, lightweight & soft to wear.

Will the Dog Bandanas fit all of the collar sizes?

Unfortunately, our Dog Bandanas are designed to fit only the Small Dog Collar, as the Large Collars are too wide to slide through. Additionally, the Bandanas are too big to be used with the XS Collar. However, you can easily use a piece of ribbon to tie the Bandana comfortably around your dog’s neck.

description.html:
Dog Collar Size. These personalised dog collars are available in three sizes:

  • Extra Small - 24-35cm long x 1.5cm wide. Clip Size: 4.5cm long x 2cm wide
  • Small - 29-44cm long x 2cm wide. Clip Size: 5cm long x 2.5cm wide
  • Large - 39-64cm long x 2.5cm wide. Clip Size: 6.5cm long x 3cm wide

This adjustable dog collar with name is designed with your pup's comfort in mind. You'll love that this is a pet ID on its own & it's silent, lightweight & so comfy your pups won't even notice they're wearing it!

The sturdy clasp keeps this custom dog collar secure through all their adventures. If they ever wander off, their name & up to two contact numbers will stand out against its plain design, making it easy for anyone to get in touch with you.

Made from durable polyester webbing, this quick-dry collar is machine-washable or can be hand-washed with soap & water. It's perfect for pups who love splashing in puddles, rolling in the mud, or enjoying the great outdoors all day.

Keep your pups safe & stylish with this personalised dog collar now. Choose from heaps of colour options & three sizes & add their name & your contact numbers. We're sure you & your pooch will love their new stylish yet comfy fit!

Love super vibrant colours on their collars? Check out our Patterned Dog Collars that are available in loads of fun designs, from clever quotes to funky patterns & even your pup's portrait!

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields will be what is printed, so please make sure to double-check your spelling.

short_description.html:
Keep your dogs safe & comfortable on every adventure with these Personalised Dog Collars, now available in 3 sizes!

Each collar is printed with your dog’s name & your contact info so they’re easy to identify wherever they go. The text will be printed on a plain solid or two-toned coloured collar, making it clear & easy to read even from a distance. Without the need for additional pet ID accessories, these eliminate jingling noises & ensure your pooch is comfy all day.

We'll print & ship your order super fast, wherever you are in Australia.
